cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json
cases=[]
# worst-case expansion: ~1.05M work units of small frames
cases.append({'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':262144,'words':1,'capacity':4096,'start':12345,
  'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':262144,'width':4096,'ranks':[0,1,2,3]}],'trace':32})
# heavy payloads with snapshots and retries
cases.append({'primitive':'allgather','mode':2,'root':1,'segments':1024,'words':1024,'capacity':1024,'start':(1<<24)-1024,
  'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':1024,'width':64,'ranks':[2,0,3,1]},{'op':'snap','tag':'mid'},{'op':'retry','rank':2},{'op':'snap','tag':'end'}],'trace':8})
# many small cases
for i in range(6):
    cases.append({'primitive':['allreduce','reduce','broadcast','barrier','allgather','reducescatter'][i],'mode':2+(i%2),'root':i%4,
      'segments':1 if i==3 else (8 if i==5 else 5),'words':0 if i==3 else 3,'capacity':4,'start':i*1000,
      'events':[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p} for p in range(1 if i==3 else (8 if i==5 else 5)) for r in range(4)]+
               [{'op':'ack','rank':r,'upto':1} for r in range(4)]+[{'op':'retry','rank':i%4},{'op':'snap','tag':'t%d'%i}],'trace':4})
open('/workspace/tmp/big.json','w').write(json.dumps({'cases':cases}))
print('input size',len(json.dumps({'cases':cases})))
"
time (cd /workspace/tmp && env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=/workspace TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 -I -B /workspace/project/solver.py < /workspace/tmp/big.json > /workspace/tmp/big.out 2>/workspace/tmp/big.err); echo "rc=$?"; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/big.out'));print('cases',len(d['cases']));
for c in d['cases']: print(c['packets'],c['bytes'],c['state'][0],c['state'][1],c['buffer'],len(c['snapshots']),len(c['trace']))
"; cat /workspace/tmp/big.err; ls /workspace/tmp
